# NEW 2026-11-24 v26.0 WP11 Full Roman Empire Theme System Expansion (4 Praetorian Prefectures + 79 Regions + E01-E10).
# Generated by gen_v260_theme_empire.py from data/oe_theme_regions_empire.json; edit the SSOT/generator, not this file.

# ZERO if/else in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 hard rule). All overlord/nullable accesses properly guarded.

# Country scope. True for the active Phoenix Imperial tag (BYZ or formed ROM).
oe_is_phoenix_empire = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
        AND = {
            trigger_if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire }
                this ?= global_var:oe_phoenix_empire
            }
            trigger_else = { always = no }
        }
    }
}

# Location scope. Null-safe ownership check for BYZ or formed ROM.
oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = {
    has_owner = yes
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_owner = yes }
        owner ?= { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Country scope. R04-safe subject check for BYZ or formed ROM.
oe_subject_of_phoenix_empire = {
    is_subject = yes
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { is_subject = yes }
        overlord ?= { oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Location scope. WP11-2 Option 2A Town/Capital Hub trigger: military/naval/frontier/Italian/Latin posts
# deploy ONLY on province capitals, region centers, towns, cities, or megalopolises (cuts posts -87%).
oe_theme_is_hub_location = {
    OR = {
        is_province_capital = yes
        has_variable = oe_theme_region_center
        location_rank = location_rank:town
        location_rank = location_rank:city
        location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
    }
}

# Location scope. WP8-3 strict urban hub trigger for oe_byz_theme_administrative_post (rural_settlement = no).
oe_theme_is_urban_hub = {
    OR = {
        location_rank = location_rank:town
        location_rank = location_rank:city
        location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
    }
}

# Theme country scope. Belongs to Praetorian Prefecture 1.
oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_prefecture }
        var:oe_theme_prefecture ?= 1

    trigger_else_if = {

        capital = { var:oe_theme_prefecture ?= 1 }
    }
    trigger_else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id }
        OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 1 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 2 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 3 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 4 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 19 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 20 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 21 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 22 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 23 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 24 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 25 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 26 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 27 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 28 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 29 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 30 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 31 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 32 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 33 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 34 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 35 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 36 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 37 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 38 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 39 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 40 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 41 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 42 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 43 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 44 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 45 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 46 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 47 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 48 }
    }
    trigger_else = {
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { exists = capital }
            capital = { OR = { region = region:anatolia_region region = region:crescent_region region = region:egypt_region region = region:caucasus_region region = region:persia_region region = region:arabia_region region = region:steppes_region NOT = { OR = { region = region:balkan_region region = region:carpathia_region region = region:italy_region region = region:maghreb_region region = region:iberia_region region = region:france_region region = region:great_britain_region region = region:north_german_region region = region:south_german_region } } } }
        }
        trigger_else = { always = yes }
    }
}

# Theme country scope. True when the Phoenix Empire has established this theme's Praetorian Prefecture (oe_prf_mode_1..4).
oe_theme_pref_has_active_praetorian = {
    is_subject = yes
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { is_subject = yes }
        OR = {
            AND = { oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes overlord ?= { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } } }
            AND = { oe_theme_in_prefecture_2 = yes overlord ?= { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } } }
            AND = { oe_theme_in_prefecture_3 = yes overlord ?= { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } } }
            AND = { oe_theme_in_prefecture_4 = yes overlord ?= { OR = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } } }
        }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Independent Prefecture & province-group unlock triggers (ZERO Italian prerequisite on East/Danube!).
oe_theme_unlock_pref1_core = { always = yes }
oe_theme_unlock_pref1_frontier_arabia = {
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_charter
        has_variable = oe_create_eastern_themes_done
        has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_won
        has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_won
        var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1
        var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2
    }
}

    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_charter

        var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2
    }
}

# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Eligibility for the 4 independent Prefecture Expansion Charter decrees (15 Authority each).
oe_theme_pref_charter_eligible_1 = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_pref_1_charter }
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_won
        has_variable = oe_hc_persia_won
        has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_won
        has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_won
        location:antioch = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
        location:jerusalem = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
        location:alexandria = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
        location:diyarbekir = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
        location:tbilisi = { oe_owned_by_phoenix_empire = yes }
    }
}
oe_theme_pref_charter_eligible_2 = {
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_pref_2_charter }
    OR = {
        var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1
